key_points: Project Overview Project Title: AI-Based Educational Content Viewer with Topic Summarization This project is being carried out at Krishna Kanta Handiqui State Open University (KKHSOU) as part of the MCA 4th Semester Industrial Project.

The project aims to develop an intelligent educational content viewer that enables students to read PDF-based study materials through an interactive digital interface and receive AI-generated summaries and learning assistance for improved understanding.

The third month of the project focused on refining and optimizing the features developed in the previous months, improving the accuracy of AI-generated outputs, performing system testing with real educational PDFs, and preparing the project for final demonstration and evaluation.
Objectives of the Project Develop an interactive and user-friendly PDF viewer for academic materials.
Implement page-wise and topic-wise AI-generated summaries.
Improve the accessibility and readability of educational PDF content.

Challenges Faced.title: Challenges Faced
Challenges Faced.summary_text: AI summarization models sometimes produced less accurate summaries for highly technical and dense academic content . Text chunking and pre-processing were improved . Performance with large PDF files with many pages caused noticeable delays in the viewer .

key_points: Summarization Quality on Dense Academic Text AI summarization models sometimes produced less accurate summaries for highly technical and dense academic content.
Resolution: Text chunking and pre-processing were improved, and prompts were refined to guide the model toward more focused summaries.
Performance with Large PDF Files Loading and rendering large PDF files with many pages caused noticeable delays in the viewer.
Resolution: Lazy loading was implemented so only the current and adjacent pages are rendered at any given time, significantly reducing load time.
